integrity: The argument is self-contained except for standard finite Markov-chain convergence and the classical Calkin-Wilf primitive-pair enumeration (both with proof sketches and citations). Finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-modulus natural-density result only; no effective uniform-in-modulus discrepancy bounds, and no classification for four or more consecutive terms. Absolute publication priority is not guaranteed.
title: Exact three-term congruence law for Stern's diatomic sequence
